configurations.name: trevora-api-local
runtimeArgs: $e='.env'; if (Test-Path $e) { Get-Content $e | ForEach-Object { $l=$_.Trim(); if ($l -and -not $l.StartsWith('#') -and $l.Contains('=')) { $kv=$l.Split('=',2); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($kv[0].Trim(), $kv[1].Trim().Trim([char]34), 'Process') } } }; & .\backend\trevora-api\mvnw.cmd -f backend\trevora-api\pom.xml spring-boot:run
